name: Driving Simulator Miami
summary:
The dream drive, from the driver's seat - in Miami.

THE CAR
A V12 with a race cockpit: racing wheel, bucket seats, roll cage, shift lights and a live display. Grip the wheel, work the stick and pull the handbrake with your own hands - or use the joysticks.

A REAL 6-SPEED MANUAL
A real H-pattern: 1 3 5 up top, 2 4 6 underneath, reverse far right. Rev to the shift lights and snap the next gear in. Prefer to cruise? Switch to automatic.
